about: Spell mechanics that change HOW a spell is used (steps, what to cast it on, what must be prepared). Non-judge DATA read by client_mod/scripts/spells.lua (state.spells `how`; two_step drives the two-cast handling). Ids from data/spells_26161880.json.

USD_Recall.how: Starting Recall opens a placement you can keep moving in; to come back to a spot, cast it with walk_to: I open it where I stand, walk there while it is held, and finish it (whether finishing returns me is checked by position). Cast without walk_to it lands where I stand. The game refuses it during its 75 s cooldown.
sources: wiki revision https://dragonwilds.runescape.wiki/?diff=58751: "Leaves a runic marker on the ground; recasting teleports you back to it. Taking a fatal fall while tethered teleports you back safely and consumes the tether."
USD_Recall.observed: live 2026-10-26 17:35-17:39 UTC (ClaudeDev): selecting Recall enters DIM_SpellPlacementModeAdvancedMovement (you can move); the place press spends 30 Air + 15 Law, starts the 75 s cooldown and plays a 1 s DominionSpellActor; pressed at once he stays put (moved 0 m). A second cast after walking 11 m placed again, no teleport; during the cooldown the game refuses it. On an invalid spot the place press does nothing (held open 12 s). Hypothesis (cast type AllowMovementThenCastInstant): the mark is where the cast STARTS; moving while it is open, then pressing place, returns you. Not yet tried.
extra_sources: game data: cast type AllowMovementThenCastInstant (the only spell of that type)

USD_FishingFrenzy.how: Cast on a fishing spot (node): each catch there gives one extra fish of the same kind while it lasts.

USD_FishCyclone.how: Cast on a fishing spot (node): pulls up to 5 fish out. You must carry a net or rod of that spot's power level or better.

USD_PileEmUp.how: Cast on fallen trees (several in a small area): turns them into one totem; follow with Splinter. Much less Woodcutting XP.

USD_Splinter.how: Cast on fallen trees: chops them into logs (25 Woodcutting XP per quarter); never stumps.

USD_RunesToRuneEssence.how: Two parts: drop the runes you want to convert on the ground first, then cast on them: gives back about 40% as rune essence.
USD_RunesToRuneEssence.setup: drop the runes on the ground

USD_DivineRock.how: Two parts: drop 5 ore (any kind) on the ground, then cast on them: they become a small personal ore node (15 ore when mined out).

USD_BonesToPeaches.how: Cast on animal bones lying on the ground (up to 10): turns them into peaches.
USD_BonesToPeaches.setup: bones on the ground (drop them, or Bark to Bones first)

USD_Treequipment.how: Cast on one standing tree: turns it into a stack of bones (pairs with Bones to Peaches).

USD_MagicalMending.how: Two parts: drop the worn weapons/tools/armour on the floor, then cast on them: +50% durability each; they return to the nearest inventory.
USD_MagicalMending.setup: drop the damaged items on the floor

USD_Farming_RapidGrowth.how: Cast on growing plots or planted trees: advances them one growth stage; can't be reapplied until they grow again.

USD_Farming_Compost.how: Needs 150 units of compost: cast on plots to fertilise up to about 4 of them.

USD_Humidify.how: Needs a watering can holding 50 units of water: waters the farming plots in a 3x5 area in front of you.

USD_Harvest.how: Harvests every fully grown crop and wild plant within 15 m and draws them to you.

USD_FerociousFurnace.how: Cast on a fire-based processing station (campfire, grill, kiln, furnace...): +90% processing speed for 30 s.

USD_SpeedupStation.how: Cast on a mechanical processing station (tannery, loom, sawmill, grindstone, stonecutter): faster processing for a while.

USD_InfernalRod.how: Needs a fishing rod equipped: for 2 minutes fish caught with it come out cooked.

USD_CorruptionArrows.how: Needs a two-handed bow equipped (not a crossbow): arrows pierce several targets; they can't be recovered.

USD_Rocksplosion.how: Needs a pickaxe carried: breaks every boulder/ore node within 5 m of the target (limited by your best pickaxe).

USD_AxtralProjection.how: Needs an axe carried: throws an axe forward, felling trees in a line up to 30 m (limited by your best axe).

USD_Confuse.how: Cast on an enemy up to 40 m away: it attacks other monsters for 45 s. Hitting it yourself breaks the spell.

USD_Enfeeble.how: Cast on an opponent: weakens its attacks.

USD_SnareTrap.how: Lays a trap at your feet: enemies that walk to its centre are rooted for 8 s; a ranged/magic hit on the star triggers it.

USD_Surge.how: Gives 3 dodge charges for 2 minutes; each dodge carries you about 8 m.

USD_Windstep.how: Jump much higher and fall slower; you have about 7 s to use it after casting.

USD_PhaseDash.how: Lets you air-dash again while airborne, up to 3 times per cast.

USD_TempestShield.how: An air shield: no damage while blocking for about a minute; if raised when it ends, it knocks nearby foes down.

USD_SummonShelter.how: Needs flat ground: summons a tent with a bed anyone can rest in; damage dispels it.

USD_HomeTeleport.how: Needs a claimed bed or bed roll: teleports you to it. 15 minute cooldown.

USD_EyeOfOculus.how: Turns your view into a floating eye (up to 30 m away) to place/remove building pieces; leave it to get your view back.

USD_DetectOre.how: Summons a spirit that leads to the nearest ore or clay within 200 m and waits there (up to 5 minutes).

USD_DetectAnimaVents.how: Summons wisps that lead to anima vents within 400 m (shown on the compass).

USD_InternalAlchemy.how: Refreshes your ACTIVE food and drink buffs (and their healing); does nothing if none are active.

USD_FireSpirit.how: A fire spirit follows you for 3 minutes and lights the way like a torch.

USD_Vengeance.how: Reflects the damage of incoming attacks back at the attackers.
